subject: 0.0.3 iPhone batch: Kokoro bucket 512, Kokoro float16 decoder retest, Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-VL-2B

device.note: os_proc_available_memory at launch without the increased-memory-limit entitlement; the 0.0.2 run on an iPhone19,4 (iOS 27.1) recorded 3,368 MiB too

signing: Release builds with automatic signing against the existing development identity and the existing wildcard team provisioning profile, which covers this device; the team was passed on the xcodebuild command line only. No -allowProvisioningUpdates; no App ID, profile, certificate or device was created, registered or modified. Each app was installed with devicectl, run with `devicectl device process launch --console`, and uninstalled afterwards; staged assets were removed.

items.item: A. Kokoro, float32 buckets, frame cap 512
B. Kokoro float16-compute decoder, decoder-only, bucket 256, preferGPU
items.detail: The float32 decoder ran its three calls (peak footprint 564 MiB). The float16-compute decoder opened and aborted on its first call with SIGABRT: MPSGraph ANERegion.mm:445 failed assertion 'ANE inference operation failed', Error Domain=com.apple.metalperformanceshadersgraph Code=-19. The macOS 27.0.1 run of 2026-10-26 failed with the same assertion message at ANERegion.mm:414. No float16 timing or accuracy was obtained.

items.item: C. Qwen3-0.6B, bucketed fp16, registered for iOS
items.signingNote: Built with CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS pointed at an empty entitlements file on the command line, because the 0.6B needs no increased memory limit and the wildcard profile cannot carry it; an empty CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS override did not take effect. The signed app carries no memory entitlement.
items.gate: text: every teacher-forced row cosine >= 0.995 against the float32 reference, argmax equal unless a near-tie (reference top-1 minus top-2 probability < 0.1 and native token in the reference top-5); greedy identical to the reference (its final stop token excluded) or first diverging at such a near-tie. vision: Kit decodes and preprocesses the photo the reference was made from; greedy identical or first diverging at a near-tie of the reference's teacher-forced row there
items.entitlement: ran without the increased-memory-limit entitlement (default app memory limit)

items.item: D1. Qwen3-VL-2B one-function, registered for iOS (4.29 GB staged), built as committed with the increased-memory-limit entitlement
items.detail: xcodebuild stopped at signing: the only profile covering the app's bundle ID is the team wildcard, which can't carry the increased-memory-limit capability. The explicit App ID with that capability is the user's to register. Nothing was installed.

items.item: D2. Qwen3-VL-2B, the same bundle, without the entitlement (empty entitlements file on the command line, as for C)
items.result: aborted while opening: std::bad_alloc in Core AI's model specialization
items.detail: The process aborted 8.7 s after launch, before the session finished opening: an uncaught std::bad_alloc from MetalPerformanceShadersGraph while MPSGraph's runtime canonicalization folded a transpose during Core AI's model specialization, SIGABRT. Not a jetsam kill (no JetsamEvent named the probe) and not a Kit refusal (the probe opens without resource admission). The default limit leaves the app 3,368 MiB at launch; the bundle's decoder and vision assets total 4.29 GB. Launch and crash timestamps are in the crash excerpt.

notVerified: Qwen3-VL-2B on device with the increased memory limit (D3, waiting on the user's App ID registration)
Kokoro float16 timing and accuracy on device (aborted)
